body:
Part of the **Veles OTP external devices** RFC execution plan (OTP-23).

Disposable but production-shaped harness: plain-Rust windowless synthetic host launched via `runtime.connectNative`, exercising Native Messaging framing/port lifecycle, WinRT and CoreBluetooth scanning/connect/GATT/subscription/whole-record I/O/disconnect/shutdown, background delivery, concurrent request IDs, and two independent phone handles against OTP-06. Records Tauri's dependency cost and macOS fresh-account TCC Bluetooth attribution (unsigned dev host vs signed production-shaped fixture). An explicit feasibility decision gates OTP-24.

**Full task specification:** see section `### OTP-23` in the RFC: docs/rfcs/2026-08-21-otp-external-devices.md (PR #79) — https://github.com/raidenyn/veles-android/pull/79

## Execution metadata

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Task ID | OTP-23 |
| Implementation order | 7 |
| Phase | Transport |
| Area | Native bridge |
| Release scope | Stable release |
| Gate | Blocks protected transport |
| Initial status | Backlog |
| Depends on | OTP-01, OTP-02, OTP-06 |

The RFC body contains the authoritative **Outcome / Scope / Exclusions / Acceptance criteria / Verification evidence** for this task.

## OTP-06 review follow-up — read before starting

Review #120 when starting this task. It tracks all eight deferred Android transport review items from PR #119, including CCCD/MTU ordering, duplicate/late callbacks, ingress cleanup and hardware concurrency. Establish real Windows/macOS central round trips and exercise two-client downstream isolation; OTP-06 verified physical advertising start/stop only. Link evidence or implementation PRs to the checklist in #120. Resolve interop-affecting Android defects before relying on this transport for protected sessions.

## OTP-23 carried-forward verification obligations


Tracking amendment from the post-grant review of #86 / PR #123 (baseline `cab043885ffe1991a6f3037c69a768ed6acbcd00`). These checklists assign future implementation/retest ownership; they do **not** mark a test PASS, waive a requirement, change dependencies, or authorize OTP-24. The current OTP-23 decision remains NO-GO until an explicit owner-approved gate amendment or satisfaction of its criteria. Only new-account W-01/M-01/M-02 are waived as nonblocking NOT RUN. Preserve earlier failed evidence and stable signing identities.

### Ownership map after the post-grant decision
**Resolve early in this issue:** (1) explicit background/Native Messaging acceptance interpretation and architectural consequences; (2) root-cause investigation of Windows intermittent `access_denied`; (3) viable macOS distribution/signing/permission-ownership model. Produce an evidence-backed recommendation for a bounded implementation gate; do not assume that such a gate amendment is approved.

The remaining development/retest obligations have explicit owners:
| Requirement | Primary owner | Integration / exit verification |
|---|---|---|
| Connected-phase window/endpoint hygiene (W-02/M-08), connected port/EOF/shutdown cleanup (W-07/W-08) | #87, connector side #88 | #94, #102, exact RC #103 |
| Current cold/prewarm foreground/provenance evidence (W-11/W-12/M-09/M-10) after owner acceptance decision | #90 | #94, #103 |
| Signed distribution pipeline (M-03), existing-account unsigned development comparison (M-11) | #89 after early feasibility here | #94, #103 |
| Exact denial/Settings recovery UX and instructions (M-04) | #88 / #89 after early ownership investigation here | #104, #103 |
| Controlled radio-off/adapter-absent/denied states (W-10) | #102; error paths implemented in #87/#88 | #103 |
| Physical duplicate-callback / CCCD-MTU edge cases (A-01) | #120 | #102 |
| Production protected repeat of synthetic M6 baseline | #101 | #102 |
| Deferred evaluator-provenance/source-hash/M6-helper and portable-test harness hardening | #102 | Gate C evidence review |

These are carried-forward **testing obligations**, not silent movement of the current OTP-23 acceptance gate. Matrix rows remain BLOCKED until actually satisfied or covered by a specific approved amendment; blocked is never PASS. New-account W-01/M-01/M-02 remain the only waived NOT RUN rows. Keep #87 dependent on #86 unless the owner explicitly approves a narrower implementation gate. All owners above already exist in project 3; no duplicate task is necessary.

comments.body: Windows-first investigation is in PR #121. Result: **NO-GO for OTP-24**. Stable Chrome on Windows connected both physical Android 15 phones at MTU 517 and isolated concurrent synthetic replies through 507 bytes. The 4095-byte case exposed the frozen profile producing 514-byte attributes, crashing Android notification delivery (512-byte API limit). Tauri 2.6.0 also creates a visible 13×13 helper window in interactive session 1. Details/evidence and pending cases are in docs/otp-23-windows.md in the PR. The fragment contract was not silently changed; an explicit protocol/RFC correction and Tauri runtime/packaging decision are needed before proceeding. macOS remains deferred, and this PR does not close OTP-23.

User-requested working PoC is now standalone PR #122. BothWindows andmacOS physically pass two-phone concurrent4096-byte records, isolation, shutdown and >610s hidden-tab delivery with targetdetached630s; safeJSON/traces committed. Android cap is opt-in, normal production wire remains frozen; plain Rust avoids Tauri runtime issue. Mac signedhost denial→usergrant→allowed_always recovery observed, but actual TCCresponsibility label/fresh-account matrix notclaimed. This is the baseline for a later production session, not automatic OTP24 or fullOTP23 approval. Handoff: docs/desktop-ble-poc.md.

Fresh contract-alignment and feasibility disposition: **#123 — NO-GO for OTP-24** (depends on still-open #122).

The RFC/contract now explicitly revise the capped GATT profile and select a plain-Rust runtime. Current dependency/SBOM/native-size evidence does **not** approve retaining Tauri for packaging; OTP-25 must choose another pipeline or bring a separately reviewed justification. OTP-24 was not implemented.

Fresh source-identified Windows/macOS native builds/tests/Clippy passed. Stable Windows Chrome passed 12 scan/lifecycle cases, and an isolated **single-phone** foreground run passed byte-exact records through 4096 bytes against the final committed Android fix. The earlier mixed-driver scan failure is retained with cause unproven. macOS's final-ID Apple Development fixture launched headlessly but returned `access_denied`; that does not prove CI signing provenance, grant ownership or recovery.

The 6T is granted and its fixture completed cleanly; the 10 Pro is still denied. Two-phone concurrent maxima, failure isolation, all active-link teardown modes, both strict background scenarios, M6 and the macOS permission/signing matrix remain unresolved. See the requirement-by-requirement matrix and exact hashes/traces in #123.

**Approved scope amendment:** tests requiring new accounts are skipped and non-blocking for OTP-23, recorded NOT RUN rather than PASS. No other acceptance waiver is implied. This issue remains open and OTP-24 remains blocked.

## Post-grant verification update — PR #123

The newly completed physical runs and independent review are integrated in #123. **OTP-23 remains open and OTP-24 remains NO-GO.**

- Two-phone synthetic size sweeps: Windows **25/25**, macOS **26/26**, including capped-budget boundaries, repeated 4096-byte records, stale handles and survivor delivery.
- M6: Windows and macOS simultaneously used the sole advertising phone, **100 × 4096-byte records each**. Independent phone-clock adjudication reproduces **16 overlapping record pairs / 1505 ms**, **900 successful API returns and callbacks per peer**, and **639 survivor notifications**. The generic desktop merger's FAIL is retained; this is scoped synthetic-transport evidence, not authenticated identity or OTP delivery.
- macOS controlled OFF → denied → ON recovery passed with the same signed binary and extension state; first timeout remains recorded.
- Windows cold/prewarm background retries passed 15 observational checks. Historical macOS 14-check adjudications passed; current re-evaluations are BLOCKED because those legacy raws lack the added foreground evidence. Literal Native Messaging exemption acceptance remains unresolved; no formal background acceptance is claimed.
- The final independent Opus review's two important findings were corrected and verified. Remaining minor harness limitations are explicitly recorded, including foreign-enclosing-git provenance, future re-evaluation hash-drift guarding, and standalone M6 helper input strictness.

Remaining acceptance blockers include signing provenance, existing-account unsigned-host testing, connected-phase window evidence, Windows port/EOF setup and radio-state cases, macOS retry guidance/prompt ownership, physical duplicate-connect/ordering proof, and the background exemption condition. Only the previously approved new-account rows are waived (`NOT RUN`, never PASS).

Canonical matrix and evidence index are in PR #123: `docs/otp-23-requirements-matrix.md` and `native-bridge/feasibility/evidence/post-grant-2026-10-26/INTEGRATION.md`. Earlier failures and signing identities are preserved. PR #123 remains unmerged and depends on open #122.
